content.hebrew: אֱלֹהַי, מַה־נּוֹרָא מַעֲשֶׂיךָ לַיֹּדְעִים,
content.transliteration: Elohay, ma nora ma‘asekha layyode‘im,
content.english: My God, how awesome are Your deeds for those who know [them];

content.hebrew: הוֹד וְהָדָר יְשַׁוּוּ לְחֹקְרָם, וּבִלְבָבוֹ שַׁעֲשׁוּעִים.
content.transliteration: Hod vehadar yeshavvu leḥoḳram, uvilvavo sha‘ashu‘im.
content.english: They place splendor and glory on the one who studies them, and delight in their heart.

content.hebrew: רָזֵי דָתְךָ – הִנֵּה מַה טּוֹב וּמַה נָּעִים!
content.transliteration: Razē datekha – hinnē ma tov uma na‘im!
content.english: The mysteries of Your Law—behold, how good and sweet they are!

content.hebrew: נוֹדְרֵי נְדָרִים, וְלֶאְסוֹר אִסָּר נִשְׁבָּעִים,
content.transliteration: Noderē nedarim, vele’sor issar nishba‘im,
content.english: Those who vow vows, and make oaths to impose deprivations [on themselves],

content.hebrew: לֹא יַחֵֽלּוּ דִבְרֵיהֶם, מִפִּיהֶם נִשְׁמָעִים.
content.transliteration: Lo yaḥellu divrehem, mippihem nishma‘im.
content.english: Must not profane their words, which are heard from their mouths;

content.hebrew: מוֹצָא שִׂפְתֵיהֶם יַעֲשׂוּ, בְּלִי רֽוּחַ עִוְעִים,
content.transliteration: Motsa siftehem ya‘asu, beli ru’aḥ ‘iv‘im,
content.english: They must do what comes out of their lips, with no spirit of confusion,

content.hebrew: וּבְמֵימֵי אֱמוּנָה יִהְיוּ נְטוּעִים.
content.transliteration: Uvmemē emuna yihyu netu‘im.
content.english: And they shall be [firmly] planted in the waters of faithfulness.

content.hebrew: וְנִדְרֵי נָשִׁים – אָב וּבַֽעַל אִם יְנִיאוּם, יִהְיוּ כַּאֲפָעִים;
content.transliteration: Venidrē nashim – av uva‘al im yeni’um, yihyi ka’afa‘im;
content.english: Women’s vows—if the father or husband abrogates them, they shall be null;

content.hebrew: אַף יָפֵֽרוּ אֹתָם, בְּשָׁמְעָם לִרְגָעִים;
content.transliteration: Af yaferu otam, beshom‘am lirḡa‘im;
content.english: Indeed, [the husband or father] may annul them, when they hear them for a moment;

content.hebrew: מִלְּבַד נִדְרֵי אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה, בַּל יִהְיוּ גְרוּעִים,
content.transliteration: Millevad nidrē almana uḡrusha, bal yihyu ḡeru‘im,
content.english: Except the vows of the widow and divorcée, which must not be withheld;

content.hebrew: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אָסְרוּ עַל נַפְשָׁן – תְּקוּעִים.
content.transliteration: Kol asher aseru ‘al nafshan – teḳu‘im.
content.english: Whatever they have deprived themselves of—they are stuck with.

content.hebrew: מַה נִּפְלְאוּ חֻקֵּי אֵל תְּמִים דֵּעִים,
content.transliteration: Ma nifle’u ḥuḳḳē El temim de‘im,
content.english: How wondrous are the statutes of God, who is perfect in knowledge,

content.hebrew: הַמַּעֲמִיק מִשְׁפְּטֵי עֵדוֹתָיו לָעָם בּוֹ נוֹשָׁעִים,
content.transliteration: Hamma‘amiḳ mishpetē ‘edotav la‘am bo nosha‘im,
content.english: Who makes profound testimonial statutes for the nation that is rescued by Him,

content.hebrew: וְנִטְעֵי דְרָכָיו לַעֲרוּגַת בֹּֽשֶׂם זְרוּעִים.
content.transliteration: Venit‘ē derakhav la‘aruḡat bosem zeru‘im.
content.english: And the saplings of whose pathways are planted for the spice beds.

content.hebrew: וְלִנְקוֹם נִקְמַת מִדְיָנִים, חַטָּאִים וְרָעִים,
content.transliteration: Velinḳom niḳmat Midyanim, ḥatta’im vera‘im,
content.english: To wreak vengeance against the Midianites, the sinful and evil people,

content.hebrew: צִוָּה יוי לְעַמּוֹ לְהֵחָלֵץ, וּלְהִתְיַצֵּב בְּכוֹבָעִים.
content.transliteration: Tsivva Adonai le‘ammo leheḥalets, ulhityats’tsev bekhova‘im.
content.english: Adonai commanded [His people] to be drafted, and to stand ready with helmets.

content.hebrew: יִדְרֹךְ עַל בָּמֳתֵי מְרֵעִים.
content.transliteration: Yidrokh ‘al bamotē mere‘im.
content.english: He trod over the backs of the evildoers.

content.hebrew: גֹּאֲלָם חָזָק, יוי, לְגָֽאֳלָם מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים,
content.transliteration: Go’alam ḥazaḳ, Adonai, leḡa’olam miyyad resha‘im,
content.english: Their redeemer, Adonai, is strong, to redeem them from the hand of the wicked,

content.hebrew: וּבְיָדוֹ לָתֵת כָּל־צַר וְאֹויֵב נִכְנָעִים,
content.transliteration: Uvyado latet kol tsar ve’oyev nikhna‘im,
content.english: And it is in His power to make every foe and enemy submissive,

content.hebrew: קהל: וְלִשְׁלֹֽחַ פְּדוּת לְבָנָיו, וְאַהֲבָה תְכַסֶּה עַל־כָּל־פְּשָׁעִים.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Velishlo’aḥ pedut levanav, ve’ahava tekhassē ‘al kol pesha‘im.
content.english: Cong. And to send deliverance to His children, and [to give] love to cover up all sins.

content.hebrew: חזן: פְּד֤וּת שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּה־לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ: (תהלים קיא:ט)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Pedut shalaḥ le‘ammo tsivva le‘olam berito ḳadosh venora shemo:
content.english: Cantor. He sent deliverance to His people; He commanded His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name! (Ps. 111:9)

content.hebrew: צַהֲלִ֥י וָרֹ֖נִּי יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי־גָד֥וֹל בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ (ישעיהו יב:ו)
content.transliteration: Tsahali varonni yoshevet tsiyyon ki ḡadol beḳirbekh ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Rejoice and sing out, dweller of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great in Thy midst! (Isa. 12:6)

content.hebrew: קהל: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (ישעיהו מז:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Go’alenu Adonai tseva’ot shemo ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Cong. Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “the Lord of Hosts.”
